text:
Marta: Heads up - I'm in Munich Mon-Wed next week. Looking for a quick Weißwurst + brezn breakfast near Marienplatz for an 8am stand-up. Any recs?
Alex: Café Frischhut - best schmalznudel & pretzels, like 2min from Marienplatz. Small tables tho.
Tobias: Donisl has covered seating and classic Bavarian vibe. A little touristy but works for groups.
Sofia: If anyone needs vegan, Max Pett does solid breakfast bowls and good coffee.
Marta: perfect. Thinking 8:15 Mon by the Marienplatz fountain?
Liam: heads up I'll be landing ~8:05, might be 10-15m late. meet by the bike rack next to the fountain? :bicyclist:
Sofia: also - for after-work drinks, currywurst place "Curry 73" near Isartor is 🔥 for late-night.
Alex: or Zum Augustiner if people want schnitzel + beer and big tables for a team.
Marta: quick poll: reply with one - brezn, vegan bowl, hotel granola, currywurst after-work
Alex: brezn
Tobias: brezn
Sofia: vegan bowl
Liam: currywurst
Marta: brezn wins, good call. I'll DM a calendar invite with location.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly on-call rotation swap tomorrow 09:00 CET - no conflicts flagged in this thread.
Marta: thanks - also anyone want to swing by a bakery run earlier? I can grab extra napkins/utensils.
Sofia: I'll grab a couple oat milk pods if you're doing coffee runs. :coffee:
Marta: Meeting spot: Marienplatz fountain (bike rack side), 8:15 Mon. Address: Marienplatz 1, 80331 München.
Marta: Agenda: 5m stand-up, then walk to Café Frischhut for brezn & coffee. If late people join, Curry 73 is plan B for post-demo drinks.
